SEE THE DIFFERENCE

A few details make your request clearer.

Illustrative examples. Your facts and choices make the prompt yours.

What you'd type

I don’t get photosynthesis.

What Promptly helps you write

Help me understand photosynthesis at high school level. Explain it step by step with an everyday analogy, then give me a practice question. Wait for my attempt before showing the answer. If I get stuck, give me a hint.

Make something clickExplore a creative idea

What you'd type

Where should we eat?

What Promptly helps you write

Help me find a casual dinner spot near campus in Austin for three friends, under $20 each, with vegetarian options. If you can browse, check current menus and opening hours and link your sources. Compare a few options and explain the tradeoffs. Tell me what you can’t verify.

Find my next favoritePlan everyday lifeFind a product

What you'd type

Write a listing for my house.

What Promptly helps you write

Write a listing description using the property facts I provide: three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a fenced yard. Audience: buyers looking for flexible living space. Tone: warm and specific. Keep it under 150 words. Include a headline, a short description, and a next step to arrange a viewing. Use only the facts provided; do not invent features.

Write a listing descriptionBuild a market strategyReply to a buyer or seller

What you'd type

Help me automate this in PowerShell.

What Promptly helps you write

Help me build an advanced PowerShell 7 script on Windows to audit inactive accounts and export a CSV. Use Microsoft Graph. Explain permissions, handle pagination and errors, and include meaningful tests. Preview results without changing accounts. Ask about any missing requirements before writing code.

Work through some codeExplain a technical concept

Promptly does not verify facts or generate AI answers. Always check the AI's response before using it.

A few questions, answered

Why doesn't Promptly just give me the answer?

It helps you write a clear request while keeping your prompt content in your browser. You choose the AI you want to use and paste the prompt there, so you stay in control.

What is a prompt?

A prompt is the request you give an AI: what you want it to do, the facts it can use, and how you want the answer to look.

Is it free, and where is my work saved?

Promptly is free and needs no account. Your work is saved in this browser on this device. Clearing browser data can remove it, so download a backup to keep an editable copy.
